snippet.title: No Love No Money — Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
Love or Money? Or destroy them both?
No Love No Money is a comedy visual novel that starts as a school dating sim and ends with a socialist revolution. Or maybe not.

Release Date: November 11
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2793540/No_Love_No_Money
